fertilizers.name: Cactus! Succulent Food
fertilizers.use: Cactus and succulents in pots.
fertilizers.rate: 2 tsp/quart (per label). Soil drench to lightly saturate — do not overwater.
fertilizers.timing: During active growing season (spring–summer). Reduce or stop in winter.
fertilizers.notes: Liquid formula gentle enough for drought-adapted plants. Companion to Dynamite Cactus granules for potted plants.

fertilizers.name: GreatWhite Mycos
fertilizers.use: All new plantings (except cactus, desert-adapted, CA natives). Soil drench for established plants.
fertilizers.rate: 1 tsp/2 gal water. Vol by canopy: 3"=2.5 gal; 6"=5 gal; 9"=7.5 gal. When mixing with other fert, base GW volume on fert amount.
fertilizers.timing: At planting and as needed for established plants.
fertilizers.notes: Promotes root development via mycorrhizal fungi. Example: 30 gal MB for 12 tea roses = add 15 tsp GW to mix.

fertilizers.name: Indoor! Houseplant Food
fertilizers.use: Indoor and potted houseplants.
fertilizers.rate: 2 tsp/quart (1.33 fl oz/gal). Soil drench to fully saturate pot soil volume.
fertilizers.timing: During active growing season. Reduce in winter.
fertilizers.notes: Gentle formula for sensitive indoor plants. Do not water after applying — rinse the fertilizer out.

fertilizers.name: MaxiCrop - Kelp
fertilizers.use: All plants — stress relief, general soil conditioning.
fertilizers.rate: 1 oz/gal. Soil drench.
fertilizers.timing: Summer — to limit heat stress. Also at planting.
fertilizers.notes: Different from Maxsea. Pure kelp extract — improves soil microbial activity and heat tolerance.

fertilizers.name: Maxsea Acid
fertilizers.use: Acid-loving plants: Japanese maple, azalea, camellia, rhododendron, blueberry, gardenia
fertilizers.rate: 1 tbsp/gal. Volume by canopy: 3-4'=2.5 gal; 4-6'=5 gal; 6'+= 10-15 gal.
fertilizers.timing: Spring and early summer. Feed before budbreak for best results.
fertilizers.notes: Use with Acidifier for Japanese maples. Seaweed-based. Excellent for acid-loving plants.

fertilizers.name: Maxsea Bloom
fertilizers.use: Flowering plants during bloom phase. Tea roses: 2.5 gal/plant.
fertilizers.rate: 1 tbsp/gal. Apply to saturation.
fertilizers.timing: When flower buds are setting. Switch from Grow to Bloom mid-summer.
fertilizers.notes: High phosphorus/potassium promotes flowering.

fertilizers.name: Maxsea Grow
fertilizers.use: Potted plants, general growth phase. Climbing roses combined with RoseTone.
fertilizers.rate: 1 tbsp/gal. Apply to soil saturation.
fertilizers.notes: Seaweed-based. Excellent for general potted plant feeding. Climbing rose mix: 5 gal MG + 3 cups RoseTone.

fertilizers.name: Urban Farms: Apples & Oranges
fertilizers.use: Citrus, fruit trees, in-ground and potted. General all-purpose liquid.
fertilizers.rate: 1 tbsp/gal. Volume: 5 gal per 6" trunk diameter. Double if struggling. Pots: 2.5 gal or less.
fertilizers.notes: Primary all-purpose liquid for citrus and guava. Pre-water dry soil. Do not water after applying to pots.

fertilizers.name: Acidifier
fertilizers.use: All acid-loving plants (same as Holly-Tone list). Japanese maple, dogwood, other winter-dormant forest plants.
fertilizers.rate: Apply at 2:1 ratio of Holly-Tone:Acidifier. Can be added directly to soil, raised beds, or potting mix.
fertilizers.timing: Rainy winter months. Often used in tandem with Holly-Tone.
fertilizers.notes: Not technically a fertilizer — no nutrients. Pure slow-release soil acidifier. Lowers soil pH for acid-loving plants.

fertilizers.name: Bio-Tone
fertilizers.use: New plantings — most Nitrogen-hungry plants. Do NOT use on cactus, desert-adapted, or CA natives.
fertilizers.rate: Up to 2 gal: 1 cup. 5 gal: 2 cups. 15 gal: 4 cups. Flower beds: 12 cups/100 sq ft. Potting soil: 1 cup/cubic ft.
fertilizers.timing: At time of planting only. Mix into backfill or potting soil.
fertilizers.notes: Mycorrhizal inoculant promotes root establishment. Mix into planting hole or blend with potting soil.

fertilizers.name: Bulb-Tone
fertilizers.use: Bulbs (tulips, daffodils, etc.).
fertilizers.rate: 1 tbsp into the planting hole, small amount on top of soil to mark site for watering in.
fertilizers.notes: Added to the planting hole. Top dusting marks the hole prior to watering in.

fertilizers.name: Citrus-Tone
fertilizers.use: Citrus trees — all types.
fertilizers.rate: Up to 3': 3 cups. 3-6': 6 cups. 7-9': 9 cups. Over 9': 12 cups. Potted: ½ cup per 5 gal soil volume.
fertilizers.timing: March through September. Remove weed cloth before applying.
fertilizers.notes: Water in heavily. Do not apply on driveways — stains concrete.

fertilizers.name: Holly-Tone
fertilizers.use: Acid-loving plants: azalea, camellia, rhododendron, blueberry, daphne, gardenia, Japanese maple.
fertilizers.rate: Trees: 1 cup/inch trunk diameter. Shrubs: 1 cup/ft drip line diameter. Beds: 15 cups/100 sq ft. New pot: 1 cup/cubic ft soil. Established pot: ½ cup/5 gal pot.
fertilizers.notes: Acidifying formula. Contains sulfur granules to lower soil pH. Alternative to Maxsea Acid for larger plants. Water in heavily.

fertilizers.name: Palm-Tone
fertilizers.use: Palms and hibiscus.
fertilizers.rate: Established plants: 1 cup per inch of trunk diameter.
fertilizers.notes: Increases foliage and blooms on palms and tropical plants.

fertilizers.name: Rose-Tone
fertilizers.use: Roses (all types) and bougainvillea.
fertilizers.rate: Individual plants: 2 cups. New in-ground: 3 cups into amended soil. Bougainvillea: 1 cup per 3' canopy diameter. Climbing rose: 5 gal MG + 3 cups RT.
fertilizers.timing: Early spring through August. Stop 6 weeks before first frost.
fertilizers.notes: Water in after application. Similar to Holly-Tone but for plants not requiring acidic soil.

fertilizers.name: Tree-Tone
fertilizers.use: Fruit, shade, and ornamental trees — primarily at planting.
fertilizers.rate: 5 gal tree: 1 cup in hole + 1 cup top-dress. 15 gal: 2 cups in hole + 2 cups top-dress. 24" box: 5 cups in hole + 5 cups top-dress.
fertilizers.timing: At time of planting. Can also be used as seasonal top-dress.
fertilizers.notes: Used to amend planting hole soil. Mix into backfill and water in well.

fertilizers.name: Bat Guano, soluble
fertilizers.use: General organic feeding — flowers, vegetables, fruiting plants.
fertilizers.rate: Per label. Typically brewed as a tea.
fertilizers.notes: High-nitrogen organic option. Brew as soil drench tea for best results.

fertilizers.name: Bulb food, Breck's
fertilizers.use: Bulbs at planting.
fertilizers.rate: Per label. Apply in planting hole.
fertilizers.notes: QB price: $9.00 / 13 oz package.

fertilizers.name: Dynamite Cactus granules
fertilizers.use: Cactus and succulents in pots.
fertilizers.rate: 2": ½ tsp. 3": ¾ tsp. 4-4.5": ½ tbsp. 6"-1 gal: 1¼ tbsp. 3 gal: 2¼ tbsp. Sprinkle and mix into top inch of soil, water in.
fertilizers.notes: Mix lightly into top inch of soil. Water in well. Size-based dosing prevents over-fertilizing.

fertilizers.name: EB Stone Azalea & Camellia Fertilizer
fertilizers.use: Azalea, camellia, and other acid-loving shrubs.
fertilizers.rate: Per label.
fertilizers.notes: QB price: $0.42 / cup.

fertilizers.name: FST
fertilizers.use: Citrus trees showing yellowing or chlorosis.
fertilizers.rate: Young trees: 1 cup per tree. Established trees: 1 cup per inch of trunk diameter. Container: ½ cup per pot.
fertilizers.timing: As needed when chlorosis is observed.
fertilizers.notes: Supplemental iron/micronutrient treatment. Use when citrus are yellowing despite regular fertilization.

fertilizers.name: Jobes Fertilizer Spikes
fertilizers.use: Shrubs and fruit/citrus trees.
fertilizers.rate: Shrubs: 1 spike per 3' shrub height. Trees by trunk diameter — 1-2": 3 spikes; 3": 5 spikes; 4": 6 spikes; 5": 7 spikes.
fertilizers.notes: Solid stakes pushed into soil at drip line. Slow-release directly at root zone.

fertilizers.name: Osmocote Plus
fertilizers.use: General purpose slow-release for landscape beds and pots.
fertilizers.rate: 1 tbsp per pot/area per label rate.
fertilizers.timing: Apply at planting or start of season.
fertilizers.notes: Controlled-release formula lasts 3-4 months.

fertilizers.name: Azalea, Camellia & Acid Planting Mix, EB Stone - 1.5 cf
fertilizers.qbName: Azalea, Camellia, & Acid Planting Mix, EB Stone - 1.5 cf
fertilizers.use: Azalea, camellia, gardenia, rhododendron, and other acid-loving plants.
fertilizers.rate: 50/50 with site soil for in-ground. Straight for containers.
fertilizers.notes: QB price: $12.00 / bag. Acidic mix — do not use for non-acid plants.

fertilizers.name: BlueRibbon potting mix - 1.5 cf
fertilizers.qbName: Blue Ribbon Blend Potting Soil - 1.5 cf

fertilizers.rate: 1.5 cf bag.
fertilizers.notes: Green Acres premium product. Higher quality than GreenAll — use for high-value or demanding container plants.

fertilizers.name: Cactus Mix, EB Stone - 1.5 cf

fertilizers.use: CA natives, succulents, xeric plants.
fertilizers.rate: Component of Native Mix (see Worm Castings notes).

fertilizers.name: EB Stone Organic Compost - 1 cf

fertilizers.rate: 50% site soil / 50% compost for most installs.
fertilizers.notes: QB price: $10.00 / bag.

fertilizers.name: EB Stone Top Coat

fertilizers.notes: QB price: $9.50 / bag.

fertilizers.name: GreenAll micro bark - 2 cf

fertilizers.rate: 2–3" layer over bed.
fertilizers.notes: QB price: $15.00 / bag. Fine texture — good for containers and small beds.

fertilizers.name: GreenAll planting mix - 2 cf
fertilizers.use: In-ground planting beds and containers.
fertilizers.rate: 2 cf bag. Blend 50/50 with site soil for in-ground, or use straight for containers.
fertilizers.notes: Green Acres product. Slightly richer than potting soil — good for in-ground installs.

fertilizers.name: GreenAll potting soil - 2 cf
fertilizers.use: General potted plants — repotting and new container plantings.
fertilizers.rate: 2 cf bag. Use as-is or blend with amendments.
fertilizers.notes: Green Acres product. Good all-purpose potting soil for most non-native container plants.

fertilizers.name: Kellogg Palm, Cactus and Citrus Potting Soil
fertilizers.qbName: Kellogg Palm, Cactus and Citrus Potting Soil
fertilizers.use: Palms, cactus, citrus in containers.
fertilizers.rate: Use straight or blend with amendments per plant type.
fertilizers.notes: QB price: $7.47 / bag. Fast-draining formula for drought-tolerant plants.

fertilizers.name: Worm Castings
fertilizers.use: All plantings. Mixed into native soil mixes and as top-dress.
fertilizers.rate: ¼" layer in soil mix or 1 cup per plant as top-dress.
fertilizers.notes: Part of Native Mix: 3:1 Cactus bulk:EB Stone Cactus + 5% compost + ¼" worm castings.

fertilizers.name: Arber Bio Fungicide
fertilizers.use: Active fungal disease on foliage.
fertilizers.rate: Per label. Dilute per instructions.
fertilizers.timing: At first sign of disease. Repeat per label interval.
fertilizers.notes: Organic fungicide. Record use on client sheet. Billable charge per application.

fertilizers.name: Mantis horticultural oil spray, mix (1.5 tbsp hort oil, 1/2 tsp sulfur)
fertilizers.use: Active pest and fungal issues on foliage.
fertilizers.rate: Mix: 1.5 tbsp hort oil + ½ tsp sulfur per spray bottle. Per label dilution.
fertilizers.timing: At first sign of pest or disease. Avoid midday application in heat.
fertilizers.notes: Do not apply in temperatures above 90°F. Avoid spraying open blooms.

fertilizers.name: Monterey Neem Oil
fertilizers.use: Soft-bodied insects, fungal disease.
fertilizers.rate: Per label. Dilute with water.
fertilizers.timing: Evening application preferred to avoid leaf burn.
fertilizers.notes: Broad-spectrum organic pesticide/fungicide. Do not apply in heat.

fertilizers.name: Mosquito Dunk
fertilizers.use: Controlling mosquito populations
fertilizers.rate: 1 dunk per 100 sq feet of sruface water

fertilizers.name: Sanco Birdbath & Fountain Cleaner
fertilizers.use: Birdbaths, fountains, water features.
fertilizers.rate: Per label — typically 1 oz per 5 gal of water.
fertilizers.notes: Keeps water features clean. Billable per application.

fertilizers.name: Sluggo
fertilizers.use: Snails and slugs — all beds.
fertilizers.rate: Scatter per label around affected plants.
fertilizers.timing: After rain or irrigation. Reapply monthly in growing season.
fertilizers.notes: Iron phosphate formula — safe around pets and wildlife when used per label.

fertilizers.name: Vinegar weed killer, mix (1 gal vin, 1 oz Dawn, 2 oz orange oil)
fertilizers.qbName: Mantis Organic Weed Killer - vinegar based
fertilizers.use: Weed control in hardscape cracks and gravel beds.
fertilizers.rate: Full strength. Apply on sunny days. Avoid contact with desirable plants.
fertilizers.notes: Mix: 1 gal 30% vinegar + 1 oz Dawn + 2 oz orange oil. Non-selective. Effective on annual weeds. Perennial weeds may need RoundUp.
